 public static double calculatePrice(

 int daysUntilDeparture,
 int maxBookingWindow,
 int bookedSeats,
 int totalCapacity,
 double alpha, // time sensitivity
 double beta // capacity sensitivity
 ) {
 // Time factor (0 → far from departure, 1 → very close)
 double timeFactor = 1.0 - ((double) daysUntilDeparture / maxBookingWindow);

 // Capacity factor (0 → empty, 1 → full)
 double capacityFactor = (double) bookedSeats / totalCapacity;

 // Final dynamic price
 return basePrice
 * (1 + alpha * timeFactor)
 * (1 + beta * capacityFactor);
 }
